rows.note: Use this for the government in power, especially an authoritarian one.

example.english: This regime controls the people through force.
example.traditional: 呢個政權靠武力控制人民。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zing3 kyun4 kaau3 mou5 lik6 hung3 zai3 jan4 man4

rows.note: For an organized system of rules or management, this is the all-purpose choice, including a prison regime.

example.english: The prison regime is so strict that inmates cannot even choose their visiting time.
example.traditional: 監獄制度太嚴，犯人連探訪時間都冇得揀。
example.jyutping: gaam1 juk6 zai3 dou6 taai3 jim4 faan6 jan4 lin4 taam3 fong2 si4 gaan1 dou1 mou5 dak1 gaan2

rows.note: Use this for a personal fitness regimen or other structured fitness programme, rather than a governing system.

example.english: I have followed this fitness regime for three months, and my shape has clearly improved.
example.traditional: 我跟住呢個健身計劃做咗三個月，身形明顯好咗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gan1 zyu6 ni1 go3 gin6 san1 gai3 waak6 zou6 zo2 saam1 go3 jyut6 san1 jing4 ming4 hin2 hou2 zo2
